candidates.summary: The loopback exception admits http://localhost:8080, Kubo's default gateway, but Kubo serves localhost as a subdomain gateway and the CSP allows only the bare origin
candidates.failure_scenario: gnoweb, strict by default, with -ipfs-gateway http://localhost:8080 (a valid case in ipfs_test.go:26) renders src=http://localhost:8080/ipfs/<cid>; Kubo's implicit PublicGateways entry for localhost sets UseSubdomains, so it answers 301 to http://<cid>.ipfs.localhost:8080/, and img-src http://localhost:8080 does not match that host on the redirect hop. Every IPFS image is blocked although the flag was accepted; http://127.0.0.1:8080, a path gateway in Kubo, works. gnodev sets no CSP, so it is unaffected.
candidates.verify_by: With a default-config Kubo daemon: curl -sI http://localhost:8080/ipfs/<cid> shows Location: http://<cid>.ipfs.localhost:8080/; run gnoweb -ipfs-gateway http://localhost:8080 on a page with ![x](ipfs://<cid>) in a headful browser: expect a CSP img-src violation on <cid>.ipfs.localhost
candidates.evidence: main.go:471 appends only `" " + ipfsGateway` to img-src; ipfs_test.go:26 lists http://localhost:8080 as valid; no Kubo binary on this machine (which ipfs: not found), so the redirect is from Kubo's documented defaults, not a run
